reference._why: Plain torch, outside the port package (the harness refuses a reference resolving inside vllm_neuron). Written directly against dsv4_ref/kernel.py:328-350 math (explicit max/exp/sum/divide, sink in the denominator only) while the triad's fallback goes through the family-19 gather-helper composition — two independent spellings of the declared math.

_tolerance_derivation: Out dtype bf16 (8-bit mantissa): faithful rounding contributes <=2^-8 relative per leg; the two legs (kernel-simulator vs torch fallback) round independently on top of fp32 accumulation-order differences (<= O(eps_f32*S) ~ 2^-18 relative at S<=16 here, S<=640 at family shapes) -> combined bound < 2^-7 relative. rtol = 2^-7 = 0.0078125 (block_fp8_linear precedent). Attention outputs are convex combinations and can sit near zero where a relative test is meaningless: for |out| < 2^-2 one bf16 ULP is <= 2^-2 * 2^-8 = 2^-10 absolute -> atol = 2^-10 = 0.0009765625 admits <=1-ULP flips there and nothing more. Fixed in the sealed prereg BEFORE any measurement; never widened (a post-hoc widening would turn the fallback into a lying discriminator for the accuracy loop).
_domain_notes: positions/context_lens omitted -> the op's warm-cache branch (mla_decode.py:289-298 at 88b34e7): plain arange addresses the whole window, all valid. topk_indices omitted with compress_ratio=0 -> dense pool scan (mla_decode.py:503-512): comp_idx = arange(span), all valid, no causal cap. 3-D contiguous caches [B, slots, 512]; no scale caches (plain bf16 storage branch); no current-row operands -> no cache write.
_uncovered_by_harness: The harness passes tensors positionally and scalars via kwargs only; tensor keyword args are inexpressible. Therefore NOT covered here and graded instead by the committed probe numerics/probe_mla_decode_tkg_supplementary.py (which reads rtol/atol FROM this declaration): 4-D paged fp8 caches with block tables, ue8m0 scale caches, current-row provenance merge, the in-kernel must-alias cache write (bitwise byte compare), sink (a tensor in positional slot 5, unreachable past the scalar slot 4), ratio>0 causal caps incl. the ratio-128 in-flight compressed case (C128 F-240 bound carried to this rung), swa_pos_offset, and the [B,1]-PAD-topk SWA-only decode form. A recorded harness-vocabulary limit, never an absorbed one (block_fp8 precedent).
